description: Digital Elevation Model (DEM) of Australia derived from SRTM with 1 Second Grid - Hydrologically Enforced WCS is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. This Service represents the National DEM 1 Second Hydrologically Enforced product derived from the National DEM SRTM 1 Second and National Watercourses, lakes and Reservoirs. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are DEM, ECOLOGY Landscape, Earth Sciences, LAND Topography Models, Published_External. It offers 3 resource(s) in html, wcs. The portal shows 2025-10-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
